reference_comparison.notes: REF-002 (t5/t20/t40/t60/t90) has richer dressed environments (sky with clouds, palms, terrain, adobe), textured characters, naturalistic sun with long contact shadows and calm centered framing, with a minimal single-line caption mid-frame. This render is cleaner and more explicit as an explainer (labels, arrows, cutaway), so mechanism and story clarity are near par, but its assets are plainer and toy-like, lighting flatter (S004 exterior), and compositions emptier (S003, S001 floor).
